title.narrative: MV IDF for Public Expend. Mgmt TA

description.narrative: " The purpose of this grant is to assist the Government of Maldives (GoM) in strengthening its public expenditure management, focusing on improving the budget formulation process. The task involves providing advice on terms of reference, suggesting qualified consultants and with experience in other countries with workshops and conferences in PEM, helping to develop the agenda for the training programs, conferences, and other activities, and providing overall supervision on the execution of the grant, as per the IDF guidelines. August 2007: With the tsunami disaster striking about one month after this IDF became effective, there have been major delays in implementation. The GoM is now moving forward with the project, and two sets of activities have been undertaken in calendar 2007 that will absorbthe bulk of the available financing. Still, some training funds are likely to remain after the closing date, and the GoM has askedfor an extension of the closing date. In September 2005, a new Finance Minister was appointed, whose commitment to strengthening medium-term budgeting, and therefore thekey development objectives of the IDF, is largely absent. Other GoM interlocutors expressed a strong desire to continue with thePEM capacity building efforts, however, and the Bank's management decided to continue (rather than cancel the IDF), with the viewto building PEM capacity for when GoM decision makers are ready to implement effective fiscal adjustment and strengthen PEM. focusing on improving the budget formulation process. This will help in (a) bolstering overall fiscal discipline, (b) better aligning public resources with the country#s development objectives, and (c) enhancing the effectiveness of public expenditure. The grant will facilitate progress towards these goals by: # Facilitating the development of a medium term fiscal framework (MTFF). # Improving the process for the appraisal and selection of capital investment projects. # Enhancing expenditure prioritization by helping the line ministries develop multi-year budgets, and facilitating efforts to cost strategic objectives and tie them to sectoral budgets."
